propositions: A snapshot entry with issuelinks key present and a bound link must produce a peer confirmation record with direction=snapshot, source=snapshot, link_id from raw entry id, and current pass_id.
A snapshot entry with issuelinks key absent must skip the entire entry (no record), treating absence as unobserved rather than evidence of empty state.
An authoritative empty issuelinks list (issuelinks=[]) must produce no record and never invalidate or remove an existing confirmation.
Links with unbound source or target keys must be skipped without raising an exception.
Inbound link relations must be mapped through link_direction.resolve_inbound_link to convert to local vocabulary (e.g., inward Blocks becomes depends_on).
Exceptions during snapshot confirmation must be logged and fail-open, allowing the reconcile pass to complete and persist without breaking the sync.
